description: Open-LIFU console application firmware for STM32F072 (Console Power PCB): HV supply control, calibration and rail monitoring, HV presets (FDA images), fans, temperature, RGB LEDs, ADS8678 ADC; binary command protocol over USB CDC. Runs from the secure bootloader's slot (0x08010400) and enters the bootloader's DFU on request.

components.name: STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32F0 (FW_F0)
components.description: STM32Cube package the HAL, CMSIS device files and middleware were generated from. The HAL / CMSIS versions actually in the tree are derived separately.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: HAL v1.7.9, CMSIS Device F0 v2.3.8 and USB Device Library v2.11.6 are the versions STM32CubeF0 v1.12.0 pins (its submodule commits); the .ioc records FW_F0 V1.12.0. Updated 2026-11-16 from V1.11.6.

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library (Core + CDC class)
components.description: USB device stack and CDC (virtual COM port) class carrying the host command protocol. Byte-identical to upstream v2.11.6, see Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/LOCAL_CHANGES.md.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: Core/ and Class/CDC/ diffed against upstream tag v2.11.6 on 2026-11-16; the version pinned by STM32CubeF0 v1.12.0.

properties.name: openwater:security-note
properties.value: Updated 2026-11-16 from v2.5.3, which passed the host's wLength unbounded into fixed EP0 class buffers (CDC 512 B hcdc->data); fixed upstream in v2.8.0. Verified on the bench console with the updated bootloader and an app built against v2.11.6.
